messages:
jonah_l: Heads-up: we're enforcing ephemeral CI credentials across org repos. Old long-lived repo PATs and stored Jenkins credentials will be disabled on Mon Jun 1, 2026 00:00 UTC. This is part of the effort to move CI to OIDC tokens + short-lived service-account tokens. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/infra/ci-ephemeral-migration :shield:

jonah_l: TL;DR:
• What: disable legacy repo PATs / Jenkins credential store named `legacy-ci-creds`
• Why: reduce risk from leaked tokens, align with Dedicated compliance profile
• Who: CI owners, infra-maintainers, and any external integrations using repo PATs
• When: enforcement starts Jun 1 00:00 UTC, detection sweep begins May 24

irene_w: Action items for teams:
1) Run the discovery script and add any findings to the migration sheet (link in runbook).
2) Migrate workflows to OIDC (recommended) or to short-lived service-account tokens.
3) Update scheduled jobs and third-party webhooks that currently use PATs.

ci-bot: Discovery commands (examples):
```
# find GH repo secrets that look like PATs
./tools/find-secrets --type gh-pat --org redwood
# scan Jenkins credentials
./tools/jenkins-scan --creds-name prefix:legacy-ci-creds
# test OIDC for a repo
./tools/oidc-check --repo org/repo --print-token
```

maya_r: For teams using Jenkins pipelines: if you can't migrate before Jun 1, create a short-lived service-account token via `redwoodctl` and update credentials. Sample Jenkinsfile snippet in runbook.

jonah_l: Example redwoodctl flow: 
```
# create ephemeral token for ci-runner
redwoodctl auth tokens create --service-account ci-runner --ttl 1h --scopes build,artifact:upload
# inject into GH Actions as OIDC-backed secret (example)
echo "$TOKEN" | gh secret set CI_EPHEM_TOKEN --repo org/repo
```

security: Reminder: any external partners still using repo PATs must be notified. Product teams, please add partner contacts to the sheet by EOD Wed May 22. We'll provide a partner migration template.

jonah_l: Detection & blocking details:
• May 24026: run automated discovery across org and DM repo owners with hits.
• Jun 1 00:00 UTC: tokens flagged as legacy will be rejected by the auth proxy (401). We will emit events to `auth.events`.
• Jun 1026 00:0000:0000:59 UTC: grace period where infra team can re-enable an allowlist entry for emergency rollbacks.

sre-oncall: Deploy impact: set up canary check to validate OIDC tokens before main rollout. If a deploy fails auth checks, deploy-bot will pause the pipeline and tag @sre-oncall.

deploy-bot: Scheduled enforcement: Jun 1 00:00 UTC 026. Will post status updates and blocked-repos digest to #eng-infra and this thread.

maya_r: Quick Q: How will we surface which repositories fail after enforcement?

jonah_l: We'll publish a nightly digest to #eng-infra with repo list + owner contact. Also push events to Console -> Security -> Auth Events. We'll attach a remediation link per repo.

irene_w: Migration helpers:
• migration-lint job will run in the next two CI cycles and comment on PRs that still reference legacy creds.
• we added templates for GitHub Actions OIDC (`.github/workflows/oidc.yml`) and Jenkinsfile examples to the runbook.

security: Note for compliance teams: this change helps satisfy short-lived credential requirements for next audit. We'll keep an audit log of all token lifecycle events for 90 days.

jonah_l: If you find a blocked external integration that needs more time, escalate to @security and @eng-infra. For migration help ping me or open an infra ticket. Thanks all. :heart:
